learn.hook: Can a pencil weigh 2 kg? Can a school bag weigh 5 g? Let us be weight detectives!
points: Check if a weight makes sense: an egg is about 50 g, a school bag about 3 kg, a cooking gas cylinder (full) about 30 kg.
To read a weighing scale, find what each small mark stands for. If 1 kg is split into 10 marks, each mark is 100 g.
A pointer 3 marks after 2 kg on such a scale shows 2 kg 300 g.
A double number line matches kg and g: 1 kg ↔ 1,000 g, 1/2 kg ↔ 500 g, 2 kg ↔ 2,000 g.
Halfway between 1 kg and 2 kg is 1 kg 500 g = 1,500 g.

example.q: A scale has 10 equal marks between 0 and 1 kg. The pointer is 4 marks past 3 kg. What is the weight?

learn.reallife: Vegetable sellers use scales with marks. Doctors use a weighing machine to check your weight.

quiz.q: Which weight makes sense for a mango?
quiz.explain: A mango is light but not tiny: about 250 g.
quiz.mistake: Does not picture the real object

quiz.q: Which is a silly weight claim?
options: A litre of milk weighs about 1 kg
quiz.explain: A pencil weighs only a few grams.
quiz.mistake: Thinks bigger numbers are always more sensible

quiz.q: A scale between 0 and 1 kg has 10 equal marks. What does each mark show?
On that scale, the pointer is 6 marks past 2 kg. What is the weight in grams?
A scale has 4 equal marks between 0 and 1 kg. What does each mark show?
On a double number line, which gram value lines up with 3 kg?
What sits halfway between 1 kg and 2 kg on a double number line?
quiz.explain: Halfway between 1,000 g and 2,000 g is 1,500 g.

quiz.q: Which is the most sensible weight for a 10-year-old child?
quiz.explain: Children of this age weigh around 25–35 kg.

teach.ask: Gappu's scale has 10 marks between 0 and 1 kg. The pointer is 7 marks past 1 kg. What does it show?
teach.praise: Each mark is 100 g, so it shows 1 kg 700 g!
teach.nudge: How much is one small mark worth?

learn.hook: Which is heavier: a kilo of cotton or a kilo of potatoes? Think carefully before you laugh!
points: Weight tells us how heavy something is.
Light things like a pencil or a coin are weighed in grams (g).
Heavy things like a sack of rice or a child are weighed in kilograms (kg).
On a balance, the heavier side goes down.

example.q: A packet of salt weighs 1 kg. A packet of tea weighs 250 g. How many tea packets weigh the same as the salt?

learn.reallife: Vegetable sellers weigh onions in kg. Sweet shops weigh barfi in grams. (And a kilo of cotton weighs the same as a kilo of potatoes!)

games.title: Lightest to heaviest
games.prompt: Put these from lightest to heaviest

quiz.q: Which unit should we use to weigh a watermelon?
quiz.explain: A watermelon is heavy, so kilograms fit best.
quiz.mistake: Picks grams for a heavy object, or a unit that is not for weight

quiz.q: Which unit should we use to weigh a 1-rupee coin?
quiz.explain: A coin is very light, so grams fit best.

quiz.q: On a balance, Riya puts a mango on one side and a lemon on the other. The mango side goes down. What does this tell us?
quiz.explain: The heavier side always goes down.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the side that goes up is heavier

quiz.q: How many grams make 1 kilogram?
Which is the heaviest?
quiz.explain: 1 kg 50 g = 1,050 g. That is more than 1,005 g and 900 g.
quiz.mistake: Reads 1 kg 50 g as 1,005 g or 1,500 g

quiz.q: 4 packets of dal weigh 250 g each. What is their total weight?
quiz.mistake: Gives the weight of one packet

quiz.q: Kabir weighs 32 kg. His little sister weighs 19 kg. How much heavier is Kabir?
quiz.mistake: Adds the weights instead of finding the difference

quiz.q: A bag holds 5 kg of rice. Meena uses 750 g. How many grams are left?
quiz.mistake: Subtracts 750 from 5 without changing kg to g, or slips with borrowing

quiz.q: Which sign goes in: 1 kg 50 g ☐ 1,500 g?
quiz.explain: 1 kg 50 g = 1,050 g, and 1,050 g is less than 1,500 g.

quiz.q: Which list goes from heaviest to lightest?
quiz.mistake: Compares the numbers written without changing them to grams first

teach.ask: Gappu asks: 'When do I use grams and when do I use kilograms?'
teach.praise: Super! Light things in grams, heavy things in kilograms, and 1 kg is 1,000 g!
teach.nudge: Which unit is for light things? How many grams make a kilogram?

learn.hook: Granny's recipe says 1 kg 250 g of flour, but the packet says grams. Let's convert like a chef!
points: kg to g: multiply by 1,000. L to ml: multiply by 1,000.
g to kg: divide by 1,000. ml to L: divide by 1,000.
Mixed units: 2 kg 350 g = 2,000 g + 350 g = 2,350 g.
Half a kg = 500 g and a quarter kg = 250 g. The same works for litres and ml.
To add or subtract, change to the same unit first.

example.q: Add 1 kg 750 g and 2 kg 500 g.

learn.reallife: Recipes, shopping lists and medicine bottles all mix kg, g, L and ml.

quiz.q: 3 kg 450 g = ? g
quiz.mistake: Writes the digits side by side without changing kg to g

quiz.q: Write 7,500 ml in litres and millilitres.
quiz.mistake: Splits the digits in the wrong place

quiz.q: For Diwali, Aisha bought 1 kg 250 g of kaju katli and 750 g of laddoos. What is the total weight?
quiz.mistake: Adds 250 + 750 but forgets the carry into kg

quiz.q: A 1 L bottle has 350 ml of water in it. How much more water will fill it?
Which is heavier: 2,500 g or 2 kg 50 g?
quiz.explain: 2 kg 50 g = 2,050 g, which is less than 2,500 g.

quiz.q: A shop has 10 kg of sugar. It packs it into 500 g packets. How many packets?
A cook uses 3 L 200 ml of milk for kheer and 1 L 900 ml for chai. How much milk in millilitres?
quiz.mistake: Forgets to carry when the ml add up to more than 1,000

quiz.q: How many grams are in a quarter of a kilogram?
quiz.explain: 1 kg = 1,000 g. A quarter is 1,000 ÷ 4 = 250 g.
quiz.mistake: Confuses a quarter with a half

teach.ask: Gappu asks: 'How do I change 3 kg 450 g into grams?'
teach.praise: Brilliant! 3 kg is 3,000 g, and 3,000 + 450 makes 3,450 g!
teach.nudge: How many grams are in each kilogram? What do I do with the 450 g?

learn.hook: A tablet of medicine weighs much less than a gram. We need an even smaller unit!
points: Very light things are weighed in milligrams (mg).
1 gram = 1,000 milligrams.
g to mg: multiply by 1,000. 3 g = 3,000 mg.
Mixed units: 4 g 100 mg = 4,000 mg + 100 mg = 4,100 mg.
mg to g and mg: 2,350 mg = 2 g 350 mg. Careful: 4 g 50 mg = 4,050 mg, not 4,500 mg.
learn.reallife: Medicine strips show amounts like 500 mg, and gold jewellers weigh very small pieces in mg.

quiz.q: How many milligrams make 1 gram?
quiz.explain: 1 g = 1,000 mg, just like 1 kg = 1,000 g.

quiz.q: Write 3 g in milligrams.
Write 4 g 100 mg in milligrams.
Write 4 g 50 mg in milligrams.
quiz.explain: 4,000 + 50 = 4,050 mg. The 50 sits in the tens and ones places.

quiz.q: Write 2,350 mg in g and mg.
quiz.explain: 2,000 mg = 2 g, and 350 mg is left.
quiz.mistake: Splits the digits in the wrong place

quiz.q: A tablet has 500 mg of medicine. How many tablets make 1 g?
Which is heavier: 1 g 80 mg or 1,800 mg?
quiz.explain: 1 g 80 mg = 1,080 mg, which is less than 1,800 mg.

quiz.q: Which unit is best for weighing a grain of rice?
quiz.explain: A grain of rice is very light, so mg is best.
quiz.mistake: Chooses a unit that is too big

teach.ask: Gappu's medicine says 1 g 250 mg. How many milligrams is that?
teach.nudge: How many milligrams are in one gram?

learn.hook: A truck carries 10 tonnes of sugarcane. How many kilograms is that? Get ready for BIG numbers!
points: 100 kg = 1 quintal. Farmers sell wheat and rice by the quintal.
1,000 kg = 1 tonne. Trucks, ships and elephants are weighed in tonnes.
Choose the right unit: mg (medicine), g (a pen), kg (a person), quintal (sacks of grain), tonne (a truck or an elephant).
Compare heavy animals with multiplication: if an elephant is about 5,000 kg and a cow about 500 kg, the elephant is about 10 times heavier.

example.q: A farmer sells 7 quintals of wheat. How many kg is that?

learn.reallife: At a mandi, grain is weighed in quintals. At a port, cargo is weighed in tonnes.

games.title: Best unit
items: A harvest of rice from a big field

quiz.q: How many kilograms make 1 quintal?
How many kilograms make 1 tonne?
A truck carries 12 tonnes of sand. How many kg is that?
A farmer has 850 kg of rice. How many full quintals is that, and how many kg are left?
How many quintals make 1 tonne?
Which unit is best to weigh a loaded goods train?
quiz.explain: A goods train is enormously heavy, so tonnes are best.

quiz.q: An elephant weighs about 5,000 kg and a cow about 500 kg. About how many times heavier is the elephant?
A rhino weighs about 2 tonnes. A hippo weighs about 3 times as much as a 500 kg buffalo. Which is heavier?
quiz.explain: Rhino = 2,000 kg. Hippo = 3 × 500 = 1,500 kg. The rhino is heavier.
quiz.mistake: Compares tonnes and kg without converting

teach.ask: Gappu heard a lorry carries 4 tonnes. How many kg and how many quintals is that?
teach.praise: 4 tonnes is 4,000 kg, and that is 40 quintals!
teach.nudge: How many kg are in 1 tonne, and in 1 quintal?

topics.title: The king's weight and cost of things

learn.hook: A king weighed 10 times as much as a 9 kg sack of rice. A year later he weighed 98 kg. How much did he gain?
points: '10 times as heavy' means multiply by 10: 10 × 9 kg = 90 kg.
Weight gained = new weight − old weight.
Cost = price per kg × number of kg. 3 kg of onions at ₹40 a kg cost ₹120.
For part of a kg: 1/2 kg costs half the price, 1/4 kg costs a quarter. 1 kg 500 g at ₹60 a kg costs ₹60 + ₹30 = ₹90.

example.q: Tomatoes cost ₹48 a kg. What do 2 kg 250 g cost?

learn.reallife: At the sabzi mandi, sellers work out prices for half and quarter kilos all day long.

items.text: From 90 kg to 98 kg he gained ___ kg
From 70 kg to 64 kg he lost ___ kg

quiz.q: A king weighs 10 times as much as a 9 kg sack. What does he weigh?
The king weighed 90 kg. A year later he weighed 98 kg. How much weight did he gain?
A prince weighs 10 times as much as a 4 kg pumpkin. Later he gains 5 kg. What does he weigh now?
Onions cost ₹40 a kg. What do 3 kg cost?
Grapes cost ₹80 a kg. What does 1/2 kg cost?
quiz.explain: Half a kg costs half the price: ₹80 ÷ 2 = ₹40.

quiz.q: Paneer costs ₹360 a kg. What does 250 g cost?
quiz.mistake: Thinks 250 g is half a kg

quiz.q: Apples cost ₹120 a kg. What do 1 kg 500 g cost?
quiz.mistake: Treats 500 g as a full kg

quiz.q: Tomatoes cost ₹48 a kg. What do 2 kg 250 g cost?

teach.ask: Gappu wants 1/2 kg of seeds that cost ₹70 a kg. How much should I pay?
teach.praise: Half a kg costs half of ₹70, which is ₹35!
teach.nudge: How does the cost of half a kg compare with the cost of 1 kg?

learn.hook: Dadi cooks 500 g of rice for 4 people. Guests are coming — now there are 8! How much rice should she cook?
points: If the number of people doubles, double the amount: 500 g for 4 → 1,000 g (1 kg) for 8.
If it halves, halve the amount: 500 g for 4 → 250 g for 2.
Unitary method: first find the value for 1, then multiply. 5 kg of scrap paper fetch ₹60, so 1 kg fetches ₹12.
A double number line shows it: 5 kg ↔ ₹60, 1 kg ↔ ₹12, 8 kg ↔ ₹96.

example.q: A scrap dealer pays ₹60 for 5 kg of newspaper. How much for 8 kg?

learn.reallife: Recipes are scaled up for weddings, and kabadiwalas pay by the kilo for old newspapers.

items.text: 500 g rice for 4 people, so for 8 people ___

quiz.q: 500 g of rice feeds 4 people. How much rice for 8 people?
quiz.explain: 8 is double 4, so double 500 g = 1,000 g = 1 kg.

quiz.q: 600 g of flour makes rotis for 6 people. How much for 3 people?
quiz.explain: 3 is half of 6, so half of 600 g = 300 g.

quiz.q: A scrap dealer pays ₹60 for 5 kg of newspaper. How much for 1 kg?
At ₹12 per kg, how much for 8 kg of newspaper?
3 kg of iron scrap fetch ₹75. How much do 7 kg fetch?
A recipe uses 250 g of sugar for 5 people. How much for 15 people?
On a double number line, 4 kg ↔ ₹100. What lines up with 6 kg?
A kabadiwala pays ₹8 a kg for plastic. Sonu gets ₹56. How many kg did he sell?

teach.ask: Gappu's mother cooks 200 g of dal for 4 birds. Now there are 12 birds. How much dal is needed?
teach.praise: 12 is 3 times 4, so 3 × 200 g = 600 g of dal!
teach.nudge: How many times more birds are there now?

learn.hook: How many glasses of nimbu pani can you pour from one big jug? Capacity has the answer!
points: Capacity is how much a container can hold.
Small amounts like medicine or a spoonful are measured in millilitres (ml).
Bigger amounts like a bottle, bucket or tank are measured in litres (L).
1 L = 1,000 ml, so half a litre is 500 ml.

example.q: A jug holds 1 L of nimbu pani. Each glass holds 200 ml. How many glasses can be filled?

learn.reallife: Milk packets, water bottles, cooking oil and petrol are all sold by capacity.

games.title: True or false?
items: A bucket holds more than a cup.

Milk can be measured in litres or millilitres.

Two 500 ml bottles fill a 1 L jug.

quiz.q: Which unit should we use for a spoonful of cough syrup?
quiz.explain: A spoonful is a small amount, so millilitres fit best.
quiz.mistake: Uses litres for very small amounts

quiz.explain: A common water bottle holds about 1 L.

teach.praise: Glug glug! Capacity is how much a thing holds, and 1 litre is 1,000 ml!
teach.nudge: What does capacity tell us about a bottle? How many ml make a litre?

learn.hook: A big jug is marked only in millilitres. Where would you draw the line for 1 litre? For 2 litres?
points: 1 litre = 1,000 ml. So on a vessel marked in ml, 1 L is at the 1,000 ml line.
1 L 500 ml is at the 1,500 ml line, and 2 L is at the 2,000 ml line.
To add amounts over several days, add the litres and the millilitres separately.
If the millilitres add up to 1,000 or more, change 1,000 ml into 1 L.

example.q: Raju drinks 1 L 600 ml on Monday and 1 L 800 ml on Tuesday. How much in all?

learn.reallife: Measuring jugs in kitchens are marked in ml, and we track water drunk each day in litres.

quiz.q: A jug is marked in ml. At which mark is 1 litre?
At which ml mark is 2 L 500 ml?

Meena drinks 1 L 600 ml on Monday and 1 L 800 ml on Tuesday. How much in all?
quiz.mistake: Does not change 1,000 ml into 1 L

quiz.q: A cow gives 4 L 500 ml in the morning and 3 L 750 ml in the evening. How much in a day?
A plant gets 750 ml of water every day. How much in 4 days?
Over three days a family uses 12 L 300 ml, 11 L 500 ml and 10 L 400 ml of milk. Total in ml?
A bottle marked in ml is filled to 1,250 ml. Is that more or less than 1 L?
quiz.mistake: Thinks 1,250 ml is less than 1 L

teach.praise: 1 L at the 1,000 ml line and 1 1/2 L at the 1,500 ml line!
teach.nudge: How many millilitres make one litre?

topics.title: Petrol pump record and comparing capacities

learn.hook: A petrol pump sold 1,250 L on Monday and 980 L on Tuesday. On which day did it sell more, and how much more?
points: A sales record table lists how much was sold each day.
To find the total, add all the days. To find how much more, subtract.
To compare capacities in mixed units, change both to ml: 2 L 50 ml = 2,050 ml.
Then use <, = or >.
learn.reallife: Petrol pumps keep daily records to know when to order more fuel.

quiz.q: A petrol pump sold 1,250 L on Monday and 980 L on Tuesday. How much on both days?
How much more was sold on Monday (1,250 L) than Tuesday (980 L)?
Record: Wed 1,075 L, Thu 1,320 L, Fri 1,500 L. On which day was the most sold?
Using Wed 1,075 L, Thu 1,320 L, Fri 1,500 L, what is the total for the three days?
Which sign goes in: 2 L 50 ml ☐ 2,500 ml?
quiz.explain: 2 L 50 ml = 2,050 ml, which is less than 2,500 ml.

quiz.q: Which sign goes in: 1,500 ml ☐ 1 L 500 ml?
quiz.explain: 1 L 500 ml = 1,500 ml. They are equal.
quiz.mistake: Thinks different units mean different amounts

quiz.q: Which holds the most?
quiz.explain: In ml: 5 L 20 ml = 5,020 ml, then 5,002 ml, 5 L 200 ml = 5,200 ml and 5,120 ml. 5 L 200 ml is the most.

quiz.q: Diesel sold on Saturday was 1,180 L, and on Sunday 245 L less. How much on Sunday?

teach.ask: Gappu must compare 4 L 40 ml and 4,400 ml. Which is more? How do I check?

learn.hook: A juice stall sells 120 glasses at ₹15 each. How much does it earn? And how many 250 ml glasses come from 30 L?
points: To multiply a capacity, change it to ml: 8 × 1 L 75 ml = 8 × 1,075 ml = 8,600 ml = 8 L 600 ml.
To share a capacity equally, change to ml and divide: 9 L ÷ 6 = 9,000 ml ÷ 6 = 1,500 ml.
Cost of milk = litres × price per litre. 1/2 L costs half the price.
Earnings = number sold × price of one.
